newsitem.title: USA: Transact Tech order doubles its GTECH sales.
newsitem.headline: Transact Tech order doubles its GTECH sales.

text.p: Transact Technologies Inc said on Monday under a new OEM agreement with GTECH Holdings Corp, it had an initial order which would more than double its sales volumes to GTECH in 1997.
The non-cancellable order specified minimum printer orders through February 1998 with an aggregate sales price of $16 million, Transact said in a statement.
"This order will more than double Transact's anticipated sales volume with GTECH in 1997 from 1996 levels," the company said.
The new OEM agreement extended terms of Transact's prior agreement with GTECH from 1998 to 2001.

Under the deal, Transact, which is 80 percent owned by Tridex Corp, said it has also agreed to provide service and replacement parts for its products at contract prices for five years after the OEM agreement expired.

"We are very pleased that our strategic relationship with GTECH, which began in 1993, is expanding in sales volume and duration under this new OEM agreement," Transact President and Chief Executive Officer Bart Shuldman said in a statement.
Transact designs, develops, manufacturers and markets transaction-based printers and related products.
